subject: Fix merge error introduced in #1186 (#1894)
reason: The fix only changes the deadline value passed to module data-type late-defrag callbacks during active defrag (monotonic endtime instead of an erroneous wall-clock conversion). Reaching defragLaterItem's OBJ_MODULE branch requires loading a module that registers a data type with a defrag callback, which the fuzzer cannot do: MODULE LOAD/LOADEX are refused in command sequences and no installed component or experiment loads modules. Without a module the branch is unreachable, and even with one the only effect is how long the module defrag callback runs before yielding — no reply, data, replicati
